title: SafeSpace Global Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: SafeSpace Global Corporation filed a Form 8-K disclosing the annual rotation of a non-independent board seat held by FKP Advisors LLC, with Ben Pope assuming the role for the second year (April 15, 2026 to April 15, 2027). The filing describes standard corporate governance arrangements including a 400,000-share restricted stock award with ratable vesting over three years and commission-based compensation for the advisor.
key_points: Non-independent board member FKP Advisors LLC seat rotates annually; Ben Pope serving second year through April 15, 2027
Restricted stock grant of 400,000 shares vests ratably on April 15, 2026, 2027, and 2028
FKP Advisors LLC eligible for 10% commission on new sales and 5% renewal commission on directly generated sales
Filing made pursuant to Item 5.02 (Departure of Directors/Compensatory Arrangements)
Company trades on OTC Bulletin Board under symbol SSGC
Signed by CEO Scott M. Boruff on April 21, 2026
